chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Muthannā, from Sadīr al-Ṣayrafī, who said:

I heard Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) saying: “Indeed, from the happiness of a man is that he should have a child in whom he recognizes a resemblance of his physical form, his character, and his traits. And indeed, I surely recognize in this son of mine a resemblance of my physical form, my character, and my traits,” meaning Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام).

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, referring here to Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)
key_terms.خَلْقِهِ: his physical form or created appearance

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) say about the resemblance of Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) to him?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a statement of Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) about a man's happiness in having a son who reflects his form, character, and traits. It specifically indicates the resemblance of Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) to him, and thus serves as a biographical and indicative report concerning the standing of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام).
